steps.text:
All 3 tests pass. 

The fix rewrote `parse_duration` to use `re.finditer` to match all `(\d+)([hms])` components in the string (e.g., `1h30m` matches `1h` and `30m`), summing each component's contribution in seconds. It validates that the whole string consists of valid unit components before returning the total, otherwise raising `ValueError`.
